title.narrative: Water Supply and Environmental Sanitation in Hajjah Governorate (Phase IV)

description.narrative: 1- The ability of a number of water wells to pump and preserve water and provide sustainable solutions for water 2- Pump and distribute potable and similar water for domestic use 3- Reducing the spread of diseases and epidemics for the displaced and citizens 4- Providing and maintaining water tanks and their surroundings, safety of sewage tanks and preventing leaks Providing toilets, maintaining a safe and sound environment, and sustaining the project’s activities with their periodic maintenance. 5- Provide designated places for waste collection, collection and disposal in a safe, environmentally healthy manner while limiting the spread of rodents and disease vectors.

Preserving the lives of the displaced and citizens by continuing to secure safe and healthy sources of water in the areas of gathering for the displaced in Hajjah Governorate (Hayran / Midi / Abs) / Safe and healthy disposal of waste and waste / Preventive maintenance of water tanks, sewage and toilets / Raising awareness of citizens and displaced people
The displaced have a clean healthy environment for (29,621) Yemeni beneficiaries
